planets.name: Kepler-37 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-37 with a 13.4-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-37 b was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-37. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 13.367308, pl_radj 0.02763855, pl_bmassj 0.00248562

quotes.title: Kepler-37b
quotes.card: Kepler-37b is an exoplanet orbiting the star Kepler-37 in the constellation Lyra.
quotes.introduction: As of February 2013, it is the smallest planet discovered around a main-sequence star, with a radius slightly greater than that of the Moon and slightly smaller than that of Mercury.
